gloss: another world; parallel world; fantasy world

definitions.gloss: another world; parallel world; fantasy world
definitions.explanation: A world different from the real one, especially a fantasy or parallel universe. Widely used as a genre term in Japanese fiction (anime, manga, light novels) where a character is transported to or reborn in a different world.

examples.japanese: {異世界|いせかい}に{転生|てんせい}する{話|はなし}だ。
examples.english: It's a story about being reborn in another world.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{異世界|いせかい}アニメが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are a lot of isekai anime lately.

examples.japanese: {主人公|しゅじんこう}はトラックにはねられて{異世界|いせかい}に{飛|と}ばされた。
examples.english: The protagonist was hit by a truck and transported to another world.

notes:
{異世界|いせかい} has become one of the dominant genre labels in Japanese pop culture since the 2010s. The term is now widely recognized even outside Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異世界|いせかい}{転生|てんせい} — reincarnation in another world
- {異世界|いせかい}{転移|てんい} — transfer to another world
- {異世界|いせかい}もの — isekai genre (stories)
- {異世界|いせかい}に{召喚|しょうかん}される — to be summoned to another world

RELATED WORDS:
- {転生|てんせい} — reincarnation
- {魔法|まほう} — magic
- {勇者|ゆうしゃ} — hero, brave warrior
